run_sensitive_log_check: run the sensitive logging check on a Python project directory to find logger.info violations
check_sensitive_logging_function: check a base directory for logger.info statements that might log sensitive request or response data
use_sensitive_log_detector_class: use the SensitiveLogDetector AST visitor class to detect logger.info calls containing sensitive data in a Python file
review_logger_info_violations: review potential violations where logger.info may log sensitive data like tokens, API keys, or request bodies
detect_sensitive_data_in_fstrings: detect sensitive data patterns in f-string interpolations and format strings passed to logger.info calls
